{{Top|leg}}
The '''war wheel''' was a siege and attack craft developed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Oskar Jyng]] for use by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It was a [[Gyroscopic stabilizer|gyro-stabilized]] disk the size of a [[Walker/Legends|walker]].<ref name="HSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
